chapter.title: Chapter Eleven: Unlicensed Improvements
chapter.subtitle: Measure twice. Stop Blue from livestreaming once.
chapter.description: A repair day becomes a contest between practical work and spectacularly unsafe inspiration.

tips: Listen for the terms before the first contest.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: Licensed electrician at noon. Safety rail team at one. Nobody improvises load-bearing art.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Blue
scenes.text: My mural concept includes a functional zip line.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: Your concept includes you going home.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: I am certified in holding the flashlight wrong.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: Give me the loose boards. Parenting taught me every object eventually becomes a drum.

scenes.speaker: Baby Momma
scenes.text: Parenting taught me to read instructions before somebody eats the screws.

scenes.speaker: OG Uncle
scenes.text: I brought work gloves and the humility to remain on ground level.

scenes.speaker: Landlord
scenes.text: Cute volunteer day. The owner still expects code compliance, not neighborhood vibes.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

starObjectives.description: Move at least one of your cards.

preDialogue.speaker: Landlord
preDialogue.text: Win and your licensed crew gets the tool cage until three.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: Lose and the same licensed crew works slower. Nobody unlicensed touches wiring.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: I have labeled the extension cords by emotional availability.

preDialogue.speaker: Landlord
preDialogue.text: I already regret the clause.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
preDialogue.text: I labeled every tool. Color-coded. Vision-board adjacent.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: You livestreamed the labeling. That’s how we got a noise complaint before the first screw.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: I printed STOP BLUE FROM LIVESTREAMING ONCE. Three fonts. Narrow one still free.

preDialogue.speaker: Cracked Head
preDialogue.text: Cage stays locked till the inspector sign. No exceptions for content.

preDialogue.speaker: OG Uncle
preDialogue.text: And no more “vision” until the paper got ink on it.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
preDialogue.text: Aight. Tools first. Narrative later. I heard y’all.

postDialogue.speaker: Landlord
postDialogue.text: Tool cage until three, exactly as announced.

postDialogue.speaker: Wifey
postDialogue.text: Electrician first. Blue's fog machine charger never.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
postDialogue.text: I withdrew that proposal before the sentence ended.

postDialogue.speaker: Cracked Head
postDialogue.text: Cage rules hold. You want a tool, you sign the sheet.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
postDialogue.text: I signed. No camera. Just the sheet.

postDialogue.speaker: Wifey
postDialogue.text: Progress. Keep it boring.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Boring is the new majestic. I’m updating the archive.

starObjectives.description: Move at least one of your cards.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

preDialogue.speaker: Nail Tech
preDialogue.text: I mixed weatherproof colors. Scammer mixed something he calls legally adjacent primer.

preDialogue.speaker: Scammer
preDialogue.text: It is eggshell-ish.

preDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
preDialogue.text: Winner chooses the mural border; the safety markings stay regulation yellow.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: My border proposal is little receipts holding hands.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: Paint line decide the safe zone. Cross it and you on the wrong side of the inspector.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
preDialogue.text: I can paint a straight line without a livestream.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: Prove it. Phone in the bucket.

preDialogue.speaker: Cracked Head
preDialogue.text: Winner set the edge. Loser hold the roller and stay quiet.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: I’m timing the quiet. Historical first.

postDialogue.speaker: Nail Tech
postDialogue.text: Border selected. Safety marks remain visible and Scammer's bucket remains closed.

postDialogue.speaker: Scammer
postDialogue.text: This is discrimination against entrepreneurial beige.

postDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
postDialogue.text: This is a lid. Put it on.

postDialogue.speaker: Cracked Head
postDialogue.text: Edge is clean. Stay behind it till the rail pass.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
postDialogue.text: Phone still in the bucket. Growth complete.

postDialogue.speaker: Wifey
postDialogue.text: Growth is temporary. Bucket is permanent. Leave it there.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Bucket inventory updated. One phone, zero live streams. Perfect score.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

phases.name: Public Pressure
phases.description: At round three, the opponent gains 1 Motion.

phases.name: Late Arrival
phases.description: At round 6, the opponent draws one card from its remaining ten-card deck. If the deck is empty, no card is added.

passive.name: Announced Terms
passive.description: The final table escalates once without changing the agreement outside the match.

preDialogue.speaker: Cracked Head
preDialogue.text: I want the last shift because I can finish it fastest.

preDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
preDialogue.text: Fast is not the commitment. Safe, documented, and leaving by nine-fifteen is.

preDialogue.speaker: Cracked Head
preDialogue.text: Then this contest picks shift lead. The inspector still approves the rail.

preDialogue.speaker: OG Uncle
preDialogue.text: Lose gracefully. Those bolts don’t care about your win rate.

preDialogue.speaker: Officer Oink
preDialogue.text: Rail either pass or it don’t. Cards don’t change the code.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
preDialogue.text: Announced term: win and we get the re-inspection window without a fine.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: Lose and we still fix it. Just slower and poorer.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: I’m labeling the rail EVIDENCE OF COMPETENCE. Don’t make me change the font.

preDialogue.speaker: Officer Oink
preDialogue.text: Font don’t impress me. Torque does.

postDialogue.speaker: Cracked Head
postDialogue.text: You lead. I log every bolt and leave on time.

postDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
postDialogue.text: Good. Your child asked if rooftop repairs mean the moon gets a fence.

postDialogue.speaker: Cracked Head
postDialogue.text: Tell them only the dangerous part. The moon remains unregulated.

postDialogue.speaker: Officer Oink
postDialogue.text: Window granted. Fix it right. I come back once.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
postDialogue.text: We’ll be ready. No camera. Just the rail.

postDialogue.speaker: Wifey
postDialogue.text: And the torque. He said torque.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Torque logged. Competence pending. Archive open.

tips: The match result and the real-world agreement remain separate.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: Rail passed. Wiring passed. Drain cleared after Cornball apologized to it.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: The drain had swallowed my auction paddle. We both needed closure.

scenes.speaker: Landlord
scenes.text: I will send the compliance report to the owner. No promises beyond that.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Red
scenes.text: A dated report is better than a promise. Send every page.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Blue
scenes.text: The wall looks good without my zip line.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: You may paint one tiny zip line with no people on it.

scenes.speaker: Baby Momma
scenes.text: Parenting pickup happened on time. Put that in the report that matters.

scenes.speaker: OG Uncle
scenes.text: The roof is safer. Next problem: make the city admit people use it.
